title: ContextSafe accepted evidence record v1
$comment: JSON Schema validates structure and calendar-valid timestamps when format checking is enabled. ContextSafe runtime validation additionally verifies the content-derived evidence_id, the cross-field case scope, and the absence of a PHI canary in the three operator-supplied provenance fields. The provenance grammars below are written as a base pattern plus named not-clauses so each exclusion states which identifier shape it makes unwritable; contextsafe.contract_validation carries these exact strings.
x-contextsafe-semantic-constraints: case_token equals CSYN- concatenated with case_id
evidence_id equals EVD- concatenated with the SHA-256 of the canonical identity payload

collector_id, system_id and system_version carry no configured PHI canary; a canary is ordinary letters and no grammar can exclude one, so this is checked by content inspection at parse time and rejected as phi_canary_detected

allOf.$comment: letter-initial, and neither a colon nor a slash is in the alphabet, so no URL scheme can be written
no run of four or more digits: makes a date, a social security number, a telephone number and a record number unwritable
every separated segment begins with a letter, so no segment is a bare number
no host label: the one URL shape the alphabet above still admits
the upper-case alphabet this field has always published; a host label needs a lower-case letter and a dot, so it cannot be written here at all
no run of four or more digits
every separated segment begins with a letter
a version is a number, not a word: the shape contextsafe.safe_value.VERSION_PATTERN already requires of a version
no run of seven or more digits
no host label in the prerelease segment
